metadata.title: Minimalist Paper-Cut Collage with Whimsical Line Art

recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist, off-white composition featuring a central black torn-paper silhouette containing a pink line-art camel, accented by a pale blue horizontal shard and celestial symbols above.
coreVisualRelationships: The black torn paper acts as a dark window for the pink line art.
The pale blue shard provides a horizontal anchor against the verticality of the black shape.
The celestial symbols (moon and star) balance the heavy central mass from the top.
Handwritten text overlaps the edge of the central black shape to create depth.
coreInvariants: Torn-edge texture on the black paper element.
Single-weight, continuous-line style for the animal illustration.
Vast negative space on an off-white background.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main graphic cluster is positioned slightly right of center, occupying approximately 30% of the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black torn-paper rectangle serves as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top celestial symbols, drops to the black shape, follows the blue shard horizontally, and finishes on the script text to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive off-white negative space surrounds the central cluster, emphasizing a sense of quiet and isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white background provides a clean, paper-like canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black creates a sharp, high-contrast focal point.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale blue and dusty pink provide soft, whimsical highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation pastels are used against high-value white and low-value black.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script and casual lowercase handwriting
letterConstructionRules: Fluid, connected strokes for the primary name
Loose, slightly disconnected lowercase for the secondary text
Variable baseline with a slight upward tilt
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'e' has a wide, open loop
Ascenders and descenders are kept short and blunt

composition.relationshipToImage: adjacent to the central black shape

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A formal, fluid script paired with a smaller, more casual and colorful handwritten sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, personal feel of the primary text.
Matches the clean but informal secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a minimalist collage on an off-white textured paper background. Place a vertical black rectangle with torn, irregular edges in the center-right. Overlap the bottom of the black shape with a long, thin, pale blue geometric shard. Inside the black shape, draw a simple pink line-art camel. At the top center, place a small black crescent moon and a tiny yellow star.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-lettered text to the left of the black shape. Use a black ink-pen style for the top line and a pale blue casual script for the line below it, ensuring the blue text slightly overlaps the black paper edge.

verificationChecks: Is the background off-white rather than pure white?
Are the edges of the black shape visibly torn/fibrous?
Is the camel drawn with a single, continuous-looking pink line?
Is there significant empty space on all sides of the central graphic?

adjustableVariables: The specific animal used in the line art
The angle of the blue shard
The degree of 'torn' texture on the black paper
mustRedesign: Specific brand names or artist signatures
Exact likeness of the camel character
postGenerationChecks: Check for torn paper texture on the black element.
Ensure the pink line art is thin and consistent.
Verify the text looks hand-written, not typed.
Confirm the blue shard has a subtle paper-like texture.
Ensure the moon and star are small and minimalist.
recipe.reuseFormula: Minimalist Paper Collage + [Central Subject in Line Art] + [Torn Paper Window] + [Horizontal Geometric Accent] + [Celestial Symbols] + [Handwritten Script]
